title: AEGIS baseline import prep: feature specification capture + frontend theming

requirements.summary: Capture the missing feature specifications as an implementable, numbered feature list with per-feature acceptance criteria and implementation notes.
acceptanceCriteria: A numbered list of features is captured with enough detail to implement each feature without further clarification.
Each feature includes user-facing copy requirements in English where applicable.
Any required data model changes are explicitly stated (entities, fields, and relationships).

file_operations.description: Create a concrete, numbered feature list document containing per-feature: user stories, required UI screens/components, data to store (if any), backend capability/integration needs (if any), roles/permissions (if any), and non-functional requirements (performance, security, limits). Ensure all user-facing copy is specified in English.

Add a prominent HTML comment near the title explaining that the app build is blocked until the feature list in frontend/docs/feature-specification.md is finalized and the AEGIS baseline source is provided (per REQ-2).

requirements.summary: Document and confirm how the AEGIS GitHub repository contents will be provided to this build environment (zip upload or specified file list) and capture any licensing/attribution requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: A clear plan is agreed for how the repo code will be provided/replicated into this project (zip upload or pasted file list).
Any licensing/attribution requirements from the repo are identified (if applicable).

file_operations.description: Create a short ingestion checklist requesting the user to provide either (a) a zip/upload of the repo contents or (b) the specific files to replicate, and a section to record licensing/attribution requirements discovered from the repo.

requirements.summary: Define and apply a coherent, Tailwind-friendly visual theme across the frontend using non-blue/non-purple primary colors and consistent typography/spacing.
acceptanceCriteria: A single theme direction (colors/typography/layout) is chosen and applied consistently.
Theme uses Tailwind-friendly tokens/classes and remains readable with sufficient contrast.
Primary colors are not blue or purple.

file_operations.description: Create the global stylesheet imported by frontend/src/main.tsx and define the app theme using CSS variables compatible with the existing Tailwind token mapping (e.g., --background, --foreground, --primary, --primary-foreground, --accent, etc.). Choose a primary color family that is not blue or purple (e.g., warm amber/green/neutral palette) with sufficient contrast for text and interactive states. Use the shadcn-ui theming approach (tokens consumed via Tailwind config). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust/extend Tailwind theme configuration as needed to support the chosen non-blue/non-purple palette and typography defaults while continuing to rely on CSS-variable-driven tokens for shadcn-ui-compatible styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
